name: Sabah bamboo pitviper
desc: A Bornean pitviper of mountain forest, usually seen on branches of shrubs; it takes small vertebrates such as frogs and rodents.
about: Trimeresurus sabahi, commonly known as the Sabah pit viper or Sabah bamboo pitviper, is a venomous pitviper species. If defined narrowly, it is endemic to the island of Borneo.
